preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 14 contains the dietary laws (parallel to Lev 11) and the tithe legislation. 1QDeutᵇ preserves fragments of vv. 21–23. Otherwise sparse Qumran attestation.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants in preserved fragments.

variant_notes: The 'do not boil a kid in its mother's milk' command tracks MT.
